SELECT DISTINCT i.ID AS id, i.PAGE_ID AS pageId, i.HISTORY_KEY AS historyKey, i.ITEM_TYPE AS itemType, i.ERA_TYPE AS eraType, i.SECTION_TITLE AS sectionTitle, i.EVENT_YEAR AS eventYear, i.SORT_NO AS sortNo, i.ITEM_HASH AS itemHash, i.CONTENT AS content, p.MONTH_VALUE AS monthValue, p.DAY_VALUE AS dayValue, p.PAGE_TITLE AS pageTitle, p.PAGE_URL AS pageUrl FROM TODAY_HISTORY_ITEM i INNER JOIN TODAY_HISTORY_PAGE p ON p.ID = i.PAGE_ID AND p.LOGIC_DEL = 0 LEFT JOIN TODAY_HISTORY_LINK l ON l.ITEM_ID = i.ID AND l.LOGIC_DEL = 0 WHERE i.LOGIC_DEL = 0 AND ( p.PAGE_TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.HISTORY_KEY LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR i.SECTION_TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR i.CONTENT LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR l.LINK_TEXT LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR l.LINK_TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR l.LINK_URL LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) ORDER BY i.EVENT_YEAR, p.MONTH_VALUE, p.DAY_VALUE, i.SORT_NO, i.ID
